Original empty output/property-info, first ordered match, missing/wrong RelationsInfo IOException, IsEncrypted alias, hidden RelationsInfo property, known-property veto, TODO property-listener no-ops, public close failure versus internal UNO-exception swallowing and destructor self-retention are preserved. Custom query bypasses XTypeProvider as source (CALC-495/WRITER426); OFOPXML alone exposes relationship identity. SDK XStream and XExtendedStorageStream retain original implicit root/two required bases; optional interfaces are not unconditional bases. StorageFormats values remain1/2/3. The parent-backed OWriteStream_Impl constructor, mutex scopes/cross-thread guarantees, physical casts/ABI/allocation failure and complete xstor hierarchy remain unported or unverified. Existing file/autosave/recovery policy is unchanged.
